title: The Case for Animal-Friendly AI
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. Its introduction briefly mentions 'Religious and secular systems' as a historical context for how humans have distinguished themselves from other animals, but this theme is not analyzed or measured in the study.

measurement_description: The paper's benchmark does not measure aspects of faith or religion. Its focus is on evaluating the degree of consideration Large Language Models (LLMs) give to the interests of nonhuman animals.
